title: Cosmos
description: Everything that is: the world, the heavens above it and the endless void of stars enveloping both, as well as the astral spaces that lie parallel to them.
summary: Everything that is: the world, the heavens, the void of stars, and the astral spaces beside them.

title: The Outer Spheres
description: A layered astral plane beyond the waking world, reached by projecting the mind out of the body. It has no ground, gravity or physics, only endless distance filled with swirling stars and drifting lights, and it grows stranger and less ordered the further out one goes. Here and there, vast structures of no earthly making float in the void.
summary: A layered astral plane reached by projecting the mind, growing stranger and less ordered the further out one goes.

title: The Pyramid
description: A pyramidal temple of stone standing in a near layer of the Outer Spheres, its spires drawing jagged lightning down from a churning sky into a central altar laid for burnt offerings. The temple is always the same, but the minds of visitors tend to paint a landscape around it, to shape the space into something more comprehensible. It was built here as a door, and the currents that run through its stone are infernal in character.
summary: A lightning-wreathed temple in the shallow Outer Spheres, built as a door.

title: The Starfield
description: The open expanse of the Outer Spheres, a black void where stars turn in a vast violet spiral around a burning core, and sparks of cold blue light drift past without ever arriving anywhere. Up and down mean nothing here. Shamblers hunt these spaces, and the living do well to fear the dark, for those they drag in here rarely return.
summary: The open void of the Outer Spheres, where stars spiral around a burning core and nothing lies underfoot.
